item.title: Palaeoclimate constraints narrow uncertainty in future Arctic winter sea ice projections
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 16 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02123-w

Forecasts of future Arctic Ocean sea ice loss can be substantially improved using Holocene proxy records by applying a model weighting approach.
item.dc:title: Palaeoclimate constraints narrow uncertainty in future Arctic winter sea ice projections
item.dc:creator: C. Y. Fu
M. B. Osman
M. A. Aquino-López

item.title: Progressive oxidative weathering raised sub-arc mantle fugacity on the Archaean Earth
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02119-6

Progressive oxidative weathering in the Archaean may have raised the proportion of oxidized sulfur recycled during subduction, suggesting a feedback between the surface and increasingly oxidized arc magmatism, according to sulfur in apatite inclusions.
item.dc:title: Progressive oxidative weathering raised sub-arc mantle fugacity on the Archaean Earth
